title: A function that calls itself is an error
query: DEFINE FUNCTION CountDown = ( n ) => IF ( n <= 0, 0, CountDown ( n - 1 ) )

expected.error: CountDown calls itself, and recursion is not supported

source.quote: Recursion or mutual recursion is not supported.
source.supports: a recursive function is not allowed

derivation: The body of CountDown calls CountDown, which the page lists as not supported, so the query fails.
